_note: Seed metadata loaded into the Admin store on first start. A synonym ending in * is the default pick when the term is ambiguous.

suppliers.description: Vendors that supply products; one supplier supplies many products.

products.description: Catalogue of sellable products with list price and cost.

customers.description: Registered customer accounts (one row per customer).

orders.description: One row per customer order (header level). Totals include shipping and tax.

order_items.description: Order line items: the many-to-many link between orders and products.

payments.description: One payment record per non-pending order (captured, refunded or failed).

reviews.description: Customer product reviews with a 1-5 star rating.

suppliers.country.description: Country where the supplier is based (not the customer's country).

suppliers.lead_time_days.description: Typical days from purchase order to delivery from the supplier.

products.unit_price.description: Current list price of the product (what it sells for today).

products.cost_price.description: What the product costs us to buy; used for margin.

products.created_at.description: Date the product was added to the catalogue.

customers.country.description: Country where the customer lives (not the supplier's country).

customers.segment.description: Customer type: Consumer, Corporate or Small Business.

customers.signup_date.description: Date the customer account was created.

orders.status.description: Order lifecycle: pending, shipped, completed, cancelled, returned.

orders.shipping_cost.description: Shipping charge billed on the order.

orders.total_amount.description: Order grand total = items + shipping + tax. Default meaning of 'revenue' at order/customer/time level.

order_items.quantity.description: Units of the product on this line.

order_items.unit_price.description: Price per unit at the time of sale (may differ from products.unit_price).

order_items.discount_pct.description: Discount applied to the line as a fraction (0.10 = 10%).

order_items.line_total.description: quantity x unit_price x (1 - discount_pct). Excludes shipping and tax. Use for product/category-level revenue.

payments.method.description: Payment method: credit_card, paypal, bank_transfer, gift_card.

payments.amount.description: Money actually charged for the order. Use only for payment/collection/refund questions.

payments.status.description: captured = money collected, refunded = returned to customer, failed.

shipments.carrier.description: Shipping carrier (DHL, FedEx, UPS, BlueDart, Royal Mail).

shipments.shipped_date.description: Date the parcel left the warehouse.

shipments.delivered_date.description: Date the parcel was delivered; NULL while still in transit.

reviews.comment.description: Free-text review comment; may be NULL.
